data.one_liner: Flutter widget for creating customizable vertical timelines.
data.what_it_does: Provides widgets for creating vertical timelines with custom markers, icons, and flexible alignment options. Supports onboarding flows, progress tracking, and interactive history displays.
use_when: You need to display a step-by-step onboarding flow.
You want to build a progress tracker or history display with custom markers.
avoid_when: You require advanced non-linear flowchart capabilities.
strengths: Supports multiple timeline positions (start, center, end).
weaknesses: Limited to vertical layout orientation based on documentation.
Documentation was created using LLMs which may contain errors.
data.minimal_example:
Timeline(
  children: [
    Marker(child: Text("Step 1")),
    Marker(child: Text("Step 2")),
    Marker(child: Text("Step 3"))
  ],
)
